notes.title: 4 Hours Remain on the Irotoridori no Sekai Kickstarter!
notes.notes:
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/solpress/irotoridori-no-sekai-a-visual-novel-by-favorite?ref=1amzo5][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28771469/77cc2454fbc3f08c9a0fb4853ed16b1c30f91a11.png[/img][/url]

A magician who can heal any wound at the exchange of his memories, and a girl in need of help. This is the foundation of the story of Irotoridori no Sekai, originally produced by visual novel producer Favorite in Japan!

Just 4 hours remain on the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/solpress/irotoridori-no-sekai-a-visual-novel-by-favorite?ref=1amzo5]Irotoridori no Sekai Kickstarter[/url], but we're almost there! We can really use all the help we can get to bring this amazing game to the west!

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/solpress/irotoridori-no-sekai-a-visual-novel-by-favorite?ref=1amzo5]You can find the Kickstarter campaign here![/url]
